name: Alex Towbin
title: Alex Towbin Photography
tagline: The emotional geometry of ordinary spaces. Exploring perspective, permanence, and uncertainty. Shot on iPhone.
about:
Alex Towbin is a Cincinnati-based photographer drawn to the interplay of light, color, form, texture, and perspective. His work spans natural and built environments, often focusing on details and relationships that might otherwise go unnoticed.

Moving between observation and abstraction, his photographs explore themes of isolation, permanence, uncertainty, and the passage of time. Some are intended to evoke an emotion or provoke thought; others simply capture the beauty of a place or moment.

For Alex, photography is an opportunity to slow down, look more closely, and see familiar things differently.
